name: thimble
description: thimble for Claude Code: Claude adds a citation to each claim you would check in its replies, and a second Claude checks each one against the files after the reply; a click on a citation opens its evidence. Claude draws interactive cards of the data, and v draws one of the last answer. Labels sort records into values, coverage says what Claude read, and /thimble:fix changes thimble itself.

counts.title: Labels and coverage on the bar
counts.description: The bar shows how much of the data Claude has seen and how many labels there are. No model call: thimble counts the files after each turn.
